title: Zkooter
tagline: Zkooter is the first web3 native social network built to replace twitter
description:
Zkooter uses Mina's zk contracts to provide attestations of wealth, allowing people to retain clout when posting all while never revealing their identity.

In addition, Zkooter fights spam bots with world coin proof of personhood.

Finally, Zkooter implements the long awaited feature of native ens domain usernames.
how_its_made:
Frontend + backend: nextjs
Database: redis
Mina network for zk attestations of wealth
Worldcoin for combating spam bots.
ENS for identifiable usernames.

I don't think I could have solved the problems I did without these technologies, especially Mina and Worldcoin.

I almost impressed myself by getting an insane css effect working but I had to scrap it due to time constraints :(
